log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stdout.

log_max_bytes.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of each log file before rotation.

log_backup_count.description: Number of old log files to retain during rotation.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

bind_host.description: Network interface to bind the service to.

bind_port.description: Port for the zone manager RPC service to listen on.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the zone manager service.

keystone_auth_uri.description: Keystone identity endpoint URI for authentication.

keystone_auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL (used for token validation).

keystone_password.description: Service password for Keystone authentication (required if using keystone auth).

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (for TLS).

enable_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption on the service endpoint.

api_base_uri.description: Base URI path for the DNS API.

max_zone_name_len.description: Maximum allowed length for zone names.

max_recordset_name_len.description: Maximum allowed length for recordset names.

storage_sql_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection string for the backend database.

storage_sql_pool_size.description: Size of the database connection pool.

storage_sql_pool_max_overflow.description: Maximum overflow connections beyond pool size.

zone_file_dir.description: Directory to store zone files (for file-based storage backend).

soa_email.description: Email address for SOA records (replace @ with zone name).

default_rrset_ttl.description: Default TTL for recordsets that do not specify TTL.

soa_serial_offset.description: Offset added to Unix timestamp when generating SOA serial.

agent_enabled.description: Enable the zone manager agent to process zone actions (e.g., create, delete).

agent_rpc_queue.description: Name of the RPC queue for agent messages.

agent_zone_action_queue.description: Name of the zone action queue.

agent_actions_per_cycle.description: Maximum zone actions processed per polling cycle.

agent_poll_interval.description: Seconds between polling for zone actions.

agent_max_queue_length.description: Maximum number of queued actions before dropping new ones.

agent_rpc_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for RPC calls from the agent.

worker_enabled.description: Enable dedicated worker mode (rarely needed for zone manager).

worker_num_workers.description: Number of worker threads in worker mode.

worker_rpc_queue.description: RPC queue name for worker mode.

api_enabled.description: Enable the internal API endpoint (for internal orchestration only; usually disabled).

api_max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size (bytes) for API requests.

api_cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS.

api_enforce_ssl.description: Enforce SSL termination proxy header for HTTPS detection.

api_secure_proxy_ssl_header.description: HTTP header used by proxy to indicate protocol (e.g., X-Forwarded-Proto).

zone_transfer_enabled.description: Enable zone transfers (AXFR/IXFR) to secondary DNS servers.

axfr_secondary_ips.description: List of allowed secondary DNS server IPs for zone transfers.
